selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Selects the strongest nonlocal geometry mechanism axis (G018-MECH-001) as a broader branch-diversification jump: damped Euclidean RoPE context between local interaction blocks directly targets ISO17 energy/gap without repeating generation_017 PaiNN/body-order/local-gate repairs.

Lower-risk readout-only companion to proposal_001 for the same G018-MECH-001 axis; isolates whether nonlocal RoPE context is useful at the least disruptive insertion point before per-layer message mixing.

Selects the MACE-style learned symmetric contraction axis (G018-MECH-002) as a genuine descriptor-family jump, replacing ad-hoc body summaries with bounded learned product-basis contractions rather than another local gate.

Selects the NequIP-inspired low-rank tensor-product interaction axis (G018-MECH-003), adding explicit scalar/vector geometric couplings that are mechanism-distinct from generation_017 norm/dot or PaiNN-style gating variants.

Small-scope first-layer tensor-product probe paired with proposal_005; preserves the G018-MECH-003 mechanism while limiting runtime and force-gradient risk, making interpretation easier if the full-stack TP branch is unstable.

Keeps the charge/global-state mechanism axis (G018-MECH-004) in the selected batch through a label-free latent conditioned readout, targeting ISO17 energy decomposition and gap from a mechanism not explored in generation_017.

Exact generation_016/proposal_002 control replicate is required because generation_017 controls were close to the parent and no child beat it; this calibrates generation_018 run variance before attributing gains to new mechanisms.

Backward-simplify diagnostic for the body/product-basis family: tests whether a smaller normalized correlation-2 body path generalizes better than the current complex body branch while remaining grounded in G018-MECH-002.

selection_policy: Prioritize broad branch diversification from the proposal-ready generation_018 evidence package: include nonlocal Euclidean RoPE context, MACE-style learned product-basis contraction, explicit tensor-product scalar/vector interaction, charge/global-state conditioned readout, an exact control, and one backward-simplify diagnostic. Avoid selecting a batch dominated by generation_017's failed PaiNN/body-order/norm-dot/readout-damping/energy-stability local repair pattern. Preserve interpretability by pairing high-scope jumps with lower-risk companions on the RoPE and tensor-product axes.
selected_mechanism_axes: G018-MECH-001: Euclidean RoPE nonlocal geometry context

omitted_proposals.reason: Conservative correlation-2 product-basis residual is useful but overlaps with selected proposal_003 and proposal_009 on G018-MECH-002; the selected pair gives a broader descriptor-family jump plus a simplification diagnostic within the same slot budget.

RoPE-plus-latent-readout hybrid combines G018-MECH-001 and G018-MECH-004, but would confound interpretation before the single-axis RoPE and latent conditioned readout proposals are measured; defer until individual axes show signal.
